newsitem.title: NORWAY: STATOIL AWARDS KAARSTOE GAS EXPANSION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: STATOIL AWARDS KAARSTOE GAS EXPANSION DEAL.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Monday it had awarded a 737 million crown contract to U.S.-British company M W Kellogg Ltd for the planned expansion of the Kaarstoe gas treatmant plant in southwest Norway.
The contract is for engineering, procurement, construction and supervision of the expansion. Work will begin immediately and is scheduled to end in autumn 2000.

Statoil said about seven billion crowns will be invested in new facilities at Kaarstoe up to 2000. The work includes construction of a gas treatment plant from the Aasgard development off mid-Norway, an ethane recovery unit and several storage and jetty installations.

Plans also include a receiving station for the pipeline from Aasgard, an export facility for the Europipe II gas trunkline to Germany and a plant for importing gas from the Draupner platforms in the North Sea.
Other companies involved in the expansion projects through various licences and partnerships are Norsk Hydro ASA, Saga Petroleum ASA, Esso, Shell, Mobil, Conoco, Elf, Neste Oy, Total and Agip.
